        int cols = Math.min(n, m);

        java.util.HashMap<Integer, Integer>[] mem = new java.util.HashMap[rows];
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) mem[i] = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        int res = dp(0, 0, 0, rows, cols, mem, BAD);
        System.out.println(cols * rows - res);
    }

    static int dp(int row, int remabove, int squareabove, int rows, int cols, java.util.HashMap<Integer, Integer>[] mem, int BAD) {
        if (row == rows) return remabove == 0 ? 0 : BAD;
        int key = (remabove << 16) | squareabove;
        if (mem[row].containsKey(key)) return mem[row].get(key);
        int res = BAD;
        int possibilities = 1 << cols;
        for (int poss = 0; poss < possibilities; poss++) {
            int have = poss;
            boolean works = true;
            for (int above = 0; above < cols; above++)
                if (((remabove >> above) & 1) == 1 && ((have >> above) & 1) == 0) {
                    works = false;
                    break;
                }
            if (works) {
                int remhere = 0;

                        remhere = add(remhere, j);
                }
                res = Math.min(res, Integer.bitCount(have) + dp(row + 1, remhere, have, rows, cols, mem, BAD));
            }
        }
        mem[row].put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

        if (index < 0) return false;
        return ((mem >> index) & 1) == 1;
    }

    static int add(int mem, int index) {

        return mem;
